name: MorphoSwarm — open problems work queue
protocol: Pick one OP id; do not work two on the same branch without noting it.
Pre-register the attempt (hypotheses + scoring) before touching held-out data, following the repo's hash-locked blind-test contract.
Report negative results as results; pruned branches stay in the graph.
Close by updating the source documents and re-running docs/build_problem_graph_html.py, whose self-checks must pass.

problems.title: Prize 1 — close the transparent-gate loophole (short runs 1≤a_i≤7)
problems.gap: Defects D1(t)=1 are proved to arrive infinitely often, but not proved to ever land on a closed gate {c_t=1}. Depth-1 right cylinder has positive topological entropy (~0.32 bits/step) on short runs, so no deeper local transducer closes this; it needs a global phase-spreading / mixing invariant.
problems.done: A proof (ideally Lean-checked) that for all t0, Π and short-run words, some D1(t)=1 lands on {c_t=1} — or a counterexample word, which would be just as valuable.

viability.note: Green/possible uses the >=15% visual threshold on the pooled posterior; individual agents may differ (see panel_range_percent).

problems.title: Prize 2 — diagonal-sample decorrelation along j=⌊S/2⌋
problems.gap: Exact 1/2 density is proved on crystals, but the diagonal sample visits a vanishing 2^-n fraction of each period and no Weyl / exponential-sum discrepancy bound exists along the moving diagonal.
problems.done: A discrepancy bound for S -> A_S(floor(S/2)) transferring crystal density to the center column, or a proof that such a bound fails.

viability.note: Green/possible uses the >=15% visual threshold on the pooled posterior; individual agents may differ (see panel_range_percent).

problems.title: Prize 3 — fixed-seed specialisation transfer
problems.gap: Multivariate deg(c_T)=2T-1 collapses under specialisation to the unit seed; a uniform Omega(T) bound needs P-vs-EXP-type machinery. Delphi posterior 0.04% — work here should be a barrier result, not another attempt at the bound.
problems.done: A formal barrier / relativisation result for the fixed-seed problem, or a specified computational model in which the bound is provable.

viability.note: Green/possible uses the >=15% visual threshold on the pooled posterior; individual agents may differ (see panel_range_percent).

problems.title: Prediction beyond the ~50 Myr horizon
problems.gap: The Thompson prediction engine collapses to a clade prior beyond ~50 Myr and the Monte Bolca test was a null result vs stasis (6/16). What, if anything, carries predictive signal at deep horizons — stem placements, fossil-calibrated priors, non-Gaussian processes?
problems.done: A pre-registered deep-horizon test (registered before unblinding, as in the FishShapes protocol) that beats the clade-prior baseline beyond 50 Myr, or a sharper null.

problems.title: Within-species bee P-matrix (the one missing input)
problems.gap: The why-wings causal decomposition is clean for hornets (within-species P) but weaker for bees, where P is within-tribe. A within-species bee wing dataset would make the hornet/bee comparison exact.
problems.done: A within-species bee forewing landmark dataset with replicates, run through the registered C1-C8 pipeline without changing its hypotheses.

problems.title: Flagship structural debt: growing-domain Turing, autonomous Meinhardt, C. elegans voxel calibration
problems.gap: Pass N+1 left these explicit: the Turing flagship lacks a 2D growing-domain solver; Meinhardt shell parameters are not autonomous; C. elegans lacks true voxel calibration (eggshell 'ASSUMED 50 um').
problems.done: Each sub-item closed by a self-test that fails on the current code and passes on the fix, with the audit score re-derived, not asserted.

problems.gap: Headline blind test was negative (LOOO AUC 0.484); orientation carries the signal (0.833) and the PCA side-split subset is suspect (clean-geometry subset 0.802). Is there any wave-feature signal once geometry is ground-truth?
problems.done: A v2 pre-registration using only ground-truth-geometry videos, scored by the hash-locked contract, whichever way it comes out.

problems.gap: Post-unblinding HTHT mirror signal (AUC 0.61-0.65) is exploratory only and confounded with headward direction because pokes were at the tail. Needs a registered test where mirror and headward predictions separate.

problems.title: Cow Turing follow-ups: independent re-score + migration-wave colonisation variant
problems.gap: The published negative verdict (static Turing rejected; growing RD vs Eden colonisation p=0.91) rests on a builder-scored Pass 9 assessment — the two blinded Fable audits (54.4, 57.7) predate the Pass 8 scale-matched pipeline. The Eden control is also a minimal interior-founder proxy, while real Holstein white invades from migration fronts; and held-out n=9 limits power.
problems.done: A blinded independent re-score of the Pass 8+ tree (audit R11), plus a neural-crest migration-wave colonisation variant scored on the same coat-masked, scale-matched statistics — published as a superseding assessment either way.

registered_prediction_followups.note: Registered predictions scored partially_resolved on 2026-10-26: outcome neither confirmed nor refuted; each names the exact missing series. Closing one means supplying that series, not re-arguing the prediction.

items.missing_evidence: Lipidation is functional in zebrafish Shh signalling: 'New chemical probes targeting cholesterylation of Sonic Hedgehog in human cells and zebrafish' (2014, doi:10.1039/C4SC01600A), and dual-lipid release biology reviewed in doi:10.1002/bies.202100133. Bound established: wild-type ShhNp is dually lipidated and tethered (repo state), and cholesterylation is required for normal signalling in zebrafish. NOT established from sources extracted: the specific registered gradient-shape claim (distal ptc-domain expansion + reduced near-source peak upon lipidation loss) in a zebrafish tissue assay. Missing data: paired ptc1/ptc2 domain measurements for lipidation-perturbed vs wild-type zebrafish Shh.

Bound established: the proportional architecture (clock period sets somite size at a given wavefront speed) is the standard, literature-supported segmentation-clock framework (zebrafish clock-mechanism studies, e.g. doi:10.1371/journal.pbio.0050150; core-circuit dynamics doi:10.1371/journal.pbio.1001364). NOT established: a paired dataset (measured T change + measured S change, wavefront controlled) sufficient to test the registered x0.80/x0.90/x1.10/x1.20 multipliers within 5 points. Missing data: paired her1-period and somite-length measurements under a controlled-wavefront perturbation, tabulated in one source.

Bound established: 3.813 is the established vertex-model jamming value carried by the dataset law. NOT established: a zebrafish (EVL/epiboly) measured shape-index transition inside 3.76-3.87; the targeted literature search returned no zebrafish shape-index transition dataset. Missing data: cell shape-index series across a zebrafish epithelial jamming/unjamming transition (measurable from published epiboly images, not yet tabulated).

Bound established: insect tracheal systems are not generically Murray-optimal (ant tracheal branching violates network-transport assumptions, doi:10.1371/journal.pcbi.1007853; Murray compliance varies by insect system, doi:10.1186/s12915-021-01130-0), consistent with the negative prediction. NOT established: a Drosophila tracheal parent/daughter diameter series sufficient to fit an exponent against the registered 2.8-3.2 band. Missing data: tabulated Drosophila tracheal diameters across branch orders.

Bound established: Xenopus somitogenesis uses a her/hes segmentation clock with a wavefront, so the proportional S~T architecture is the applicable framework (cross-species replication target of ZF-CLK-01). NOT established: paired Xenopus period-manipulation + somite-length measurements sufficient to test the x0.80-x1.20 multipliers within 5 points. Missing data: paired clock-period and somite-length series under controlled wavefront conditions in Xenopus.
